reason: ₹22,000 is almost two months of what my family earns, and ₹2,000 every month for a year is too much when my wife already washes by hand for free. Nobody in my village has this machine yet, so I would not be the first to take the risk.
objection: After 3 years the battery will die, and nobody tells me what a new one costs. The dealer is in the block town, so who comes to my village when it breaks and how long do we sit without it?
would_change_my_mind: A relative or neighbour using it for a year without trouble, plus the dealer writing down the replacement battery price and promising village repair visits, and an EMI closer to ₹1,000 a month.
